name: ultrasound through pregnancy overview
title: Pregnancy ultrasound: in the first trimester the most advanced landmark visible dates the pregnancy (gestational sac by mean sac diameter, yolk sac which confirms an intrauterine pregnancy but does not date it, then crown-rump length, handing over to fetal biometry after 14 weeks); the 18 to 22 week anatomy scan then checks the number of fetuses, the placental location and the fetal anatomy; each column gives when it is seen, what is read and what follows

root.title: Pregnancy ultrasound: which landmark DATES it, and what the 18–22 week scan checks
lines: ultrasound beats the last menstrual period for the delivery date · transvaginal first; transabdominal is as good for a crown-rump length after 6 weeks
bleeding, viability, ectopic or molar pregnancy: see the FIRST-TRIMESTER BLEEDING chart

groups.title: DATING SCAN, ideally 7–12 weeks: which landmark can you see?
lines: offer it to every woman · the most advanced landmark dates it; each retires the one before

groups.title: ANATOMY SCAN at 18–22 weeks: EVERY pregnant person in Canada
lines: a SCREEN with five jobs · the fifth, soft markers for trisomy 21 or 18, is on the GENETIC SCREENING chart

head: h
Gestational sac
mean sac diameter (MSD)
then: MSD > 14 mm, OR an embryo is seen

head: h
Yolk sac
first structure inside the sac
see: • CAN be seen at MSD 5–6 mm
• SHOULD be seen at MSD 8 mm (5+5 weeks)
read: up to 6 mm by 10 weeks, then gone
then: keep the MSD until an embryo appears

head: h
Embryo
crown-rump length (CRL)
read: Longest straight line, head to rump
then: Date by the EARLIEST scan with CRL > 10 mm
equal to the biparietal diameter (BPD) at 12–14 weeks

head: h
Fetal biometry
after 14 weeks
read: Past CRL 84 mm, BPD is more reliable
then: Dates it ONLY if not already done

head: h
Number of fetuses
see: a 1st trimester scan for a suspected multiple: reliable chorionicity, amnionicity
read: A full anatomy scan of EACH fetus

head: h
Placental location
read: placental edge to the internal os

head: h
Screen of fetal anatomy
the main job
then: → further genetic testing or more detailed imaging
• place of delivery, level of care

panels.title: Why not the last menstrual period?
items: it assumes regular 28-day cycles, ovulation mid-cycle, correct recall, off the pill for months
even with correct recall, ovulation to implantation varies by up to 11 days
early ultrasound dating has cut inductions for post-term pregnancy
